title: A Delivery Nobody Could Have Made

scenes.narration: The loading bay camera shows a delivery at three this morning. We take no deliveries at night, and the shutter was locked.
scenes.imagePrompt: An empty concrete loading bay at night with a roller shutter half raised onto pure darkness outside, no people, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.text: ONE BOX. OUT OF THE DARK.
scenes.narration: The shutter goes up on its own. No van. A man in a long coat carries one box in from the dark and sets it down.
scenes.imagePrompt: A man in a long dark coat bending to set a cardboard box down on a loading bay floor, the open shutter behind him black, seen from behind, no face visible, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: The box is still there. It is addressed to the security office, to me by name.
scenes.imagePrompt: A single cardboard box sitting alone in the middle of a concrete loading bay floor under one working ceiling light, no people, seen from a high corner security camera, wide-angle lens distortion, soft low-resolution video texture, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.text: IT'S SIGNED FOR IN MY HAND
scenes.narration: The delivery note is signed for, in my handwriting. I have not opened the box.
